items.text: Ko, zvino Moreki atorerei nhaka yaGadhi?
Nemhaka yeiko vanhu vake vachigara mumaguta ayo?
pamwe chete navaprista vake namachinda ake.
Dzokai uye mutize, muwande mumapako akadzika,
Vana vake, nehama dzake navavakidzani vake vachafa,
Siya nherera dzako; ini ndicharwira upenyu hwavo.
Zvanzi naJehovha: "Kana avo vakanga vasingafaniri kunwa pamukombe vakodzera kuunwa, iwe ucharegereiko kurangwa? Haungaregi kurangwa, asi unofanira kunwa pamukombe wacho.

Ndinopika neni ndimene," ndizvo zvinotaura Jehovha, "kuti Bhozira richava dongo nechinhu chinonyangadza, nechinhu chinotyisa, chinozvidzwa nechinotukwa; uye maguta aro ose achava matongo nokusingaperi."
Ndakanzwa shoko rakabva kuna Jehovha, richiti:
Kunyange ukavaka dendere rako pakakwirira segondo,
uye vachaseka nokuda kwamavanga aro ose.
pamwe chete namaguta akanga akavakidzana nawo,"
ndichadzinga Edhomu kubva munyika yake pakarepo.
Ndianiko akasarudzwa wandichagadza kuti aite izvi?
Ndiani akafanana neni uye ndiani angakwikwidzane neni?
Naizvozvo, inzwai zvakarongwa naJehovha pamusoro peEdhomu,
achaparadza chose mafuro avo nokuda kwavo.
Nyika ichadedera nokuda kwomubvumo wokuwa kwavo;
kuchema kwavo kuchanzwikwawo kusvikira kuGungwa Dzvuku.
varwi varo vose vachati mwiro pazuva iroro,"
Pamusoro peKedhari noumambo hweHazori, hwakarwiswa naNebhukadhinezari mambo weBhabhironi:
Matende avo namapoka avo amakwai achatorwa;
Garai mumapako akadzika, imi vagari vomuHazari,"
"Nebhukadhinezari mambo weBhabhironi aita zvakaipa pamusoro penyu;
Ndichaparadzira kumhepo avo vari kunyika dzokure,
uye ndichauyisa njodzi pamusoro pavo kubva kumativi ose,"
Iri ndiro shoko raJehovha rakasvika kuna Jeremia muprofita pamusoro peEramu, pakutanga kwokubata ushe kwaZedhekia mambo weJudha, richiti:
uye ndichaparadza mambo wayo namachinda ayo,"
